summary: Malformed/oversized numeric literal could throw FormatException/OverflowException out of Evaluate.
fix: ParseFactor now uses decimal.TryParse and throws ParseException (→ DisplayTotalParseError) on failure; added '=Sum(.)' and oversized-literal tests.

summary: Broad catch swallowed Controls-enumeration failures, allowing silent omission of derivable totals.
fix: Removed the broad catch; a Controls-enumeration failure now propagates so ReadSpec fails and the report is recorded Failed (surfaced), not silently empty. Per-property TryRead* stay soft.

summary: No coverage for malformed-numeric path or COM section classification.
fix: Added malformed-literal cases and extracted the pure ReportFooterSection classifier with hermetic ReportFooterSectionTests (footer vs page-footer vs group-footer, label mapping).
